title: Intercom API Review: Full Developer Breakdown [2026]
snippet:
**Intercom's REST API**, currently at [version 2.15](https://developers.intercom.com/docs/references/introduction), covers more ground than most APIs in the customer service category. The docs are public at [developers.intercom.com](https://developers.intercom.com/), official SDKs cover six server-side languages, rate limits are published at 10,000 calls per minute per app, and the endpoint catalogue spans contacts, conversations, tickets, help center articles, workflows, and the Fin AI Agent.

| **Rate limits** | [10,000 calls/min](https://developers.intercom.com/docs/references/rest-api/errors/rate-limiting/) per app; 25,000 calls/min per workspace |

| **Pricing / access** | Included on all paid plans; [$29/seat/mo](https://www.intercom.com/pricing) entry (Essential, billed annually) |

No permanent free API tier; the 14-day trial ends and access stops without a paid plan |

API access starts with any paid **Intercom** plan.
The [pricing page](https://www.intercom.com/pricing) lists API access across Essential ($29/seat/month), Advanced ($85/seat/month), and Expert ($132/seat/month), with no separate developer signup or API-specific fee. A [14-day cardless free trial](https://www.intercom.com/legal/terms-and-policies) gives access to the full API during the trial period.

**Intercom** bundles API access into its paid plans rather than charging per call or per credit. The [pricing page](https://www.intercom.com/pricing) lists API access across all three tiers:
| **Plan** | **Seat price (billed annually)** | **API access** |
|---|---|---|
| **Essential** | $29/seat/month | Included |
| **Advanced** | $85/seat/month | Included |
| **Expert** | $132/seat/month | Included |
There are no per-call charges, no API-specific credit costs, and no metered pricing. Private app development workspaces are free to create but limited in functionality and restricted to the US region.
The real cost for a developer building on this API is not the API itself but the platform features the API operates within:
- **Fin AI Agent:** [$0.99 per resolved outcome](https://www.intercom.com/pricing) on top of the seat subscription, charged only when Fin resolves a conversation. Unresolved handoffs to humans are not charged.
- **Copilot (unlimited usage add-on):** $29/agent/month on [annual prepay](https://www.intercom.com/help/en/articles/9121384-copilot-included-and-unlimited-usage) beyond the 10 free conversations per agent per month included in all plans.

title: Set up a Workspace | Intercom and Fin Developer Platform
snippet:
### For public app developers
If you are building a public app to share with multiple customers, you **must** [create a new development workspace](https://www.intercom.com/signup/developer) to develop and publish the app.
Development workspaces are free and intended for development purposes only.
You can create as many development workspaces as you would like.

### Expert: $132/seat/month (annual) or $139/seat/month (monthly)
Adds SSO and identity management, HIPAA support, SLA management, workload management, a multibrand Messenger, multibrand help center, team office hours, team reply time settings, extended API limits, a real-time dashboard, and 50 Lite seats.
Best for: Large teams that need advanced security controls, multibrand support, and powerful workflow and workload management features.

Intercom offers a 14-day free trial with no credit card required. During the trial, you get access to your chosen plan along with Fin AI Agent and the Pro, Copilot, and Proactive Support Plus add-ons.
After the trial period, add your payment details to continue. There is no automatic charge during the trial.
If you need more time, eligible customers may be offered a 7-day self-serve trial extension from Day 13 onward. If that option is not available, you can request an extension by contacting support through the Messenger.

The Early Stage program gives eligible startups heavily discounted access to the Advanced plan:
-   **Year one:** 93% off ($33/month)
-   **Year two:** 50% off
-   **Year three:** 25% off
-   **300 free Fin AI outcomes per month** in year one
-   **Included:** 2 full seats, 2 Copilot seats, Proactive Support Plus, and the Pro add-on
**Eligibility:** Raised under $10M in funding, fewer than 15 employees, and a new Intercom customer.

### Is there a free plan?
No. Intercom does not offer a permanent free plan. The 14-day free trial is the evaluation option, and the Early Stage program is available for eligible startups.

title: Intercom developer FAQs
snippet:
You can[ create a new developer workspace](https://app.intercom.com/a/developer-signup) for developing apps. Developer workspaces are free and intended for development purposes only. Once you've created the new workspace you can[ follow this guide](https://developers.intercom.com/docs/build-an-integration/getting-started/) to create an app and make your first API call.

Private apps have a default rate limit of 10,000 API calls per minute per workspace, shared by all private apps in the workspace. This means that if a workspace has multiple private apps installed, every one contributes towards the same total.
Public apps have a default rate limit of 10,000 API calls per minute for each app and 25,000 API calls per minute per workspace. This means that if a workspace has multiple public apps installed, each one has its own separate request limit without contributing to the others. More information on rate limits is available in our [developer documentation](https://developers.intercom.com/docs).
